results.rationale: Independent two-cohort design (n₁ = 14, n₂ = 12). Both cohorts conform to normal distributions, but variance homogeneity is violated (Heteroscedasticity: F(11, 13) = 28.58, p = < .001). Welch's t-test with Satterthwaite degrees of freedom is required to control Type I error rates.

varianceEquality.note: Not required for paired repeated measures (within-subject differencing removes inter-subject variance).

results.rationale: Paired / repeated measures design (10 paired observations). Within-subject differences (Δ = Post - Pre) conform to normality (Jarque-Bera p = 0.584, Skewness = -0.37). The parametric Paired Samples t-test is recommended.
